sonicScene.thesis: Contour Valley: a landscape as a sculptural colour field. You skim a glowing river down a winding valley between smooth hills coloured by their height in hard bands, ruled with contour lines that flow up the slopes with the music; the river rises and brightens with the bass.

composition.background: the valley's far bends and gold walls dissolving into a cream horizon under a cobalt sky
composition.midground: enormous banded hills, groves of cone trees, crystals on the crests
composition.foreground: the turquoise river under the camera, the valley's walls sweeping past
composition.post: a soft bloom on the river and the crystals
composition.camera: a low glide along the river, banking through the bends

palette.saturation: saturated warm bands; turquoise and cobalt accents

very_slow: the land rising as a piece builds
medium: the contour lines flowing up the slopes
extremely_fast: a band of light running out across the land

vocabulary: the river rises up its banks and brightens
the contour lines flash white across the land; the river surges
the contour lines flow up the slopes
pollen sparks over the river; the contour lines brighten
the whole palette drifts (hue) and the haze warms
STRUCTURE: the land rises (the hills grow taller as the piece builds)
the land breathes (a slow swell rolls through it)
twelve families of crystals, one per pitch class, light on their crests
the river's glow widens with the chord
STRUCTURE: the contour spacing (fine survey lines to broad terraces)
the glide goes on down the valley
sonicScene.tier: light: one smooth heightfield (three copies), baked groves and crystals, four unlit programs, no lights
sonicScene.title: Chromatic Topography
